claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.destinationRestriction.keyed_plane_face
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation + charge-pool shape fits, but the surface cannot constrain a granted spell's destination to a cube face's keyed plane. Cubic Gate does not grant generic Gate or Plane Shift access; it grants item-mediated casts whose destination is fixed by the pressed side.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Gate. Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.destinationRestriction.keyed_plane_face
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The same missing shape is pressured by the second spell mode as well. Plane Shift from the cube is not an unrestricted cast; it transports targets to the plane keyed to the chosen side.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Plane Shift. Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast Plane Shift, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side."
